content: function  NvM_GetErrorStatus  [SWS_CP_MEM_00006]   Std_ReturnType NvM_GetErrorStatus(NvM_BlockIdType BlockId, NvM_RequestResultType* RequestResultPtr); Queries the result of the last asynchronous single-block or multi-block operation (NVM_REQ_OK, NVM_REQ_NOT_OK, NVM_REQ_PENDING, NVM_REQ_INTEGRITY_FAILED). Memory Abstraction Interface (MemIf) MemIf abstracts multiple memory hardware drivers (Flash EEPROM Emulation Fee and EEPROM Driver Ea) into a uniform linear 32-bit address space.
